plan: docs/RSA-Documents/HARVESTING_PLAN.md §5 (Track A access paths), §3 (ODD matrix and priority cells), §7 (split). The plan lives in the operator checkout (/Users/akamel/Documents/AuditorAI) and is read-only; this file remains the source list of record.
note: Track A source list with the per-source outcome of the M6 run. Hosts not listed under "sources" are listed under "unfillable" with the reason they cannot be filled by Track A and the Track B/C handoff.

politeness.note: Crawl-delay is read from each host's robots.txt at fetch time and honoured before every request (src/discovery/robots.ts).

split_rule.quarantine: documents whose licence verdict is not CLEAR are never train and never test
split_rule.note: licence verdict CLEAR only: QC + AB are test geography, every other province is train. RESTRICTED documents stay in the corpus and are excluded from train and test (repo practice for canada/*, LICENSE-REGISTER.md). BLOCKED (terms forbid reuse) goes to quarantine/track-a/ with a QUARANTINE.md bullet.

hash_rule.note: A document whose sha256 is already in the union of those three sets is never written to disk and never enters the intake manifest.

sources.plan_ref: §5 Track A: open.alberta.ca - no fee, immediate download
sources.robots_hint: Disallow /api/, /dataset/rate/, /dataset/*/history; Crawl-delay: 10. The CKAN search page is client-rendered and /api/ is disallowed, so Track A can only fetch known document URLs.

licence_default.basis: Open Government Licence - Alberta (open data portal)

outcome.note: The one known CKAN resource URL is already in the corpus (Track A run 1: CLEAR, T3, FEASIBILITY_CONCEPT). The CKAN catalogue is not enumerable without the robots-disallowed /api/ path.

sources.family: Alberta open government publications (road safety audit series)
sources.robots_hint: The /publications/<slug> pages are server rendered and carry the resource URL; the resource pages under /dataset/... are allowed (Crawl-delay: 10). The publication pages show the licence per resource.

licence_default.basis: Alberta open government portal publication whose resource page states "No licence" - public access, reuse needs the publisher's sign-off

outcome.note: The Alberta Transportation 2004 RSA Guidelines (2004-rsa-guidelines-final-report.pdf) and RSA Implementation Plan (2004-rsa-implementation-plan-final-report.pdf) are already in the corpus (docs/RSA-Documents/canada/canadian/). Both portal pages show "No licence", so the verdict would have been RESTRICTED and the split "restricted".

sources.robots_hint: Disallow /search*, /gov/search*, /en/search/, /query.html*; document pages and /assets/ allowed. The /search* endpoints are unusable, so discovery runs off the sitemap index (12 asset sitemaps, ~89k PDFs).

sources.robots_hint: Disallow /api/ and faceted /*?*tags= queries; Crawl-delay: 10. Only the atom feed (20 most recent datasets), /group/<name> pages and /dataset/<slug> pages are readable.

sources.robots_hint: Allow all except /wp-admin/, /news/* and /legdocs/mmis/<year>/<sv|sx|sy|sz>/ for 2009-2026, /legdocs/mmis/<year>/dg/ for 2019-2026, /legdocs/mmis/2018/ex/. The committee codes ie, ex (2019+), dg (2009-2018) and pw are therefore fetchable; the document ids are opaque, so the URLs come from the public search index rather than from a City listing.

licence_default.basis: Crown copyright (City of Toronto works) - public access, reuse needs owner sign-off

outcome.note: The four reachable legdocs/Vision Zero documents are road safety *plans* (Vision Zero 2.0, the 2023 and 2024 updates, the 2025 annual report), not road safety *audits*: the RSA classifier rejects them. The City publishes no index of legdocs files (every directory URL answers 404) and the document ids are opaque, so the audit reports themselves are not enumerable from Track A.

The reachable Vision Zero documents are road safety plans, not audits.
